AI Coding Market & Token Arithmetic [M/S · unmetered]

Reconciles API tokens (~0.75 words/tok) in a16z's USD 2.25/query example (100k in + 10k out tokens -> USD 9,450/yr at 4,200 queries/yr) and contrasts +21% to +55.8% developer RCT speedups with METR's -19% slowdown.

1/2 Realized spend vs trillion-dollar TAMs [S]:
- Menlo Ventures USD 4.0B 2025 AI coding spend, Cursor >USD 1B ARR, Claude Code >USD 2.5B ARR & MSFT Q3 2025 USD 4.1B OpenAI loss vs USD 2.6T-4.4T TAMs
- Agentic loops burn ~1,000x chat tokens with 30x same-bug spread (Bai 2026)

2/2 Mixed developer RCTs [S]:
- Greenfield/corporate tasks: Peng et al. (2023) +55.8% (N=95); Paradis et al. (2024) ~+21% (N=96)
- Mature OSS repos: METR / Becker et al. (2025) found 16 experienced maintainers were 19% SLOWER across 246 real issues
- Unmetered (joules = null)
